paragraphs.source_zh: “不，不是不吉利。去年不是好几次差点到阎王爷那里去了一趟，结果又回来了吗？今年当然还是这样。菖蒲，我如战死，你会为我哭泣吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Young lord…” Ayame did not answer. She gripped Nobuyasu tightly with both hands.

units.source_en: “Young lord…” Ayame did not answer. She gripped Nobuyasu tightly with both hands.
units.source_zh: “少主……”菖蒲没有回答，她两手紧紧地抓住信康。

paragraphs.source_zh: “少主……”菖蒲没有回答，她两手紧紧地抓住信康。

paragraphs.source_en: “I am very fond of you. Mother does not understand affection. That is why I flew into a rage and punished Mangetsu somewhat too harshly.”

paragraphs.source_en: “I have caused you no small amount of worry as well. Just as Father said, I, Nobuyasu, still have much tempering to undergo before my character is worthy.”

paragraphs.source_en: At times Nobuyasu displayed an inexplicable weakness and tenderness, but never before had he moved Ayame as deeply as he did that night. At heart, he was kind. Could it be that, in this world, a warrior who sought to preserve an image of strength was tormented by endless anxiety and expressed his conflicted mind through drunken rampages?

paragraphs.source_en: “Ayame, forgive me. After I die, you alone in this world will weep for me from the bottom of your heart. You alone are truly sincere toward me.”

units.source_zh: “菖蒲，请你原谅，在我死后，这个世上只有你一人会从心底为我哭泣，只有你一个人对我是真心的。”

units.source_en: “Yes… yes.”

paragraphs.source_en: Was it Kikuno's unexpected appearance that had allowed Ayame to discover a new Nobuyasu? No, it was more than that. She also began to reflect on things she had never before perceived. Nobuyasu's genuine feelings for her left her at a loss.

units.source_en: Was it Kikuno's unexpected appearance that had allowed Ayame to discover a new Nobuyasu?
units.source_zh: 难道是由于菊乃的意外出现，才使菖蒲发现了一个新的信康吗？

units.source_en: No, it was more than that.

ja.t: いや、それだけではない。

units.source_en: She also began to reflect on things she had never before perceived.

units.source_en: Nobuyasu's genuine feelings for her left her at a loss.
units.source_zh: 信康对她的真情让她很狼狈。

paragraphs.source_zh: 难道是由于菊乃的意外出现，才使菖蒲发现了一个新的信康吗？不，不仅如此。她也开始反思以前从没有意识到的事。信康对她的真情让她很狼狈。

paragraphs.source_en: It must have been nearly the Hour of the Hare when Nobuyasu drifted peacefully to sleep. Ayame went to move the lamp away, but then she saw the extraordinary stillness of Nobuyasu's sleeping form. For an instant, as though bewitched, an ominous thought flashed through her mind: What would she do if Nobuyasu truly died?

units.source_en: It must have been nearly the Hour of the Hare when Nobuyasu drifted peacefully to sleep.
units.source_zh: 大概快到卯时了，信康安详地睡去。

units.source_en: Ayame went to move the lamp away, but then she saw the extraordinary stillness of Nobuyasu's sleeping form.
units.source_zh: 菖蒲想把灯拿开，却看见信康那异常安静的睡姿。

units.source_en: For an instant, as though bewitched, an ominous thought flashed through her mind: What would she do if Nobuyasu truly died?

units.source_zh: 一刹那，她像着了魔，心头掠过一个不祥的念头：如果信康真的死了，那怎么办……

paragraphs.source_zh: 大概快到卯时了，信康安详地睡去。菖蒲想把灯拿开，却看见信康那异常安静的睡姿。一刹那，她像着了魔，心头掠过一个不祥的念头：如果信康真的死了，那怎么办……

paragraphs.source_en: Though the thought lasted only an instant, Ayame realized that she too loved Nobuyasu madly, with her whole being. She raised her head and gazed silently at Nobuyasu without blinking, utterly entranced. Nobuyasu lay asleep on the bed, knowing nothing of this.

units.source_en: Though the thought lasted only an instant, Ayame realized that she too loved Nobuyasu madly, with her whole being.
units.source_zh: 虽然就这么一闪念间，菖蒲却发现原来自己竟也发疯般地、全身心地爱着信康。

units.source_en: She raised her head and gazed silently at Nobuyasu without blinking, utterly entranced.
units.source_zh: 她抬起头来，眼睛一眨不眨，默默看着信康，看得入了神。

units.source_en: Nobuyasu lay asleep on the bed, knowing nothing of this.
units.source_zh: 信康睡在床上，对此一无所知。

paragraphs.source_zh: 虽然就这么一闪念间，菖蒲却发现原来自己竟也发疯般地、全身心地爱着信康。她抬起头来，眼睛一眨不眨，默默看着信康，看得入了神。信康睡在床上，对此一无所知。

paragraphs.source_en: Ayame had forgotten the waves of cold assailing her and shook her head fiercely. She could never explain to her lady what had happened when Kikuno was taken away. She despaired.

paragraphs.source_en: Outside, the cold wind still howled, and branches in the courtyard brushed against the wooden shutters with a rustling sound. The oil lamp in the corridor seemed close to burning out and cast only a faint glow.

paragraphs.source_en: “The young lord… has already loved Ayame.” Murmuring the words, she seemed drawn by some unseen force and walked straight toward the wooden shutter screened by the garden trees.

units.source_en: “The young lord… has already loved Ayame.”

units.source_en: Murmuring the words, she seemed drawn by some unseen force and walked straight toward the wooden shutter screened by the garden trees.

paragraphs.source_zh: “少主……已经喜欢过菖蒲了。”她嘴里念叨着，像被什么东西吸引了过去，径直走到庭木掩映着的木板套窗前。

paragraphs.source_en: In truth, misfortune is not something one can distinctly feel approaching. Nobuyasu loved Ayame deeply. Rather than saying that a single remark from Lady Tsukiyama drove Ayame to her death, it would be truer to say that Ayame herself wished to die. She believed that all of it had been ordained by fate. She approached the window and gently opened a gap seven or eight inches wide. The cold wind cut into her body like a knife, and her damp eyelashes stung again and again.

units.source_en: In truth, misfortune is not something one can distinctly feel approaching.

paragraphs.source_en: “Young lord, I am going on ahead. Ayame will go first…” Ayame thought that everyone must die someday in any case. And with that, she vanished into the darkness.

paragraphs.source_en: For an instant, his gaze was riveted to the spot—Ayame was hanging from a pine tree in the courtyard, her feet very, very close to the ground.
